purpose: SEALED held-out validation set for the RFC-0120 C3 decision rule (P1). These cases were NOT used to derive the rule — they come from git windows OUTSIDE the derivation window (2026-05-22..29). They were mined + leg-scored + verdicted by BLIND agents who were NOT told the 4-leg EMIT rule (they judged only against the RFC-0117 §2.1 bar). The rule was then applied mechanically to their leg-scores and compared to their independent verdicts. This is the VALIDATION gate; the derivation oracle (c3-detector-oracle.json) is only a CONSISTENCY check.
do_not_merge_into_oracle: Adding these cases to c3-detector-oracle.json would re-contaminate the held-out set (ISC-A1). They live separately ON PURPOSE.

protocol.blind: Two general-purpose agents mined disjoint held-out windows (A=2026-05-08..20, B=<=2026-05-07). Each got the 7 leg definitions + the RFC-0117 §2.1 bar, scored legs with evidence, and gave an INDEPENDENT bar-verdict. Neither was given the 4-leg EMIT rule.
protocol.rule_applied: EMIT iff (ge10_or_overflow) AND (deterministic_merge_core in {true,partial}) AND (NOT already_served_elsewhere) AND (long_running) — applied to the agents' leg-scores, prediction computed before comparison.

result.interpretation: The rule generalizes to 12 cases it was never fit to. 0/11 false-emits is strong evidence against over-emission (the expensive error for a propose-only detector).
honest_caveats: Only 1 held-out EMIT, and it (reflection-mining-upgrade-scan, the DOSUpgrade MineReflections shape) is the SAME FAMILY as the derivation emit dos-upgrade-scan. Generalization to a STRUCTURALLY-DIFFERENT emit is still unproven — the emit side rests on 1 same-family point.
Held-out set is skip-dominated (11/12), like the derivation set (13/16). Skip-side generalization is well-tested; emit-side precision is tested by 1 case.
Ground truth is the blind agents' bar-verdicts, not an oracle — a second blind pass could disagree on a borderline. None here were borderline, but that is the residual epistemic limit.
